# 虛空孕菩薩經

**ID:** T0408
**Volume:** T13
**Category:** 大集部類
**Original Category:** 大集部
**Byline:** 隋 闍那崛多譯
**Dynasty:** 隋
**Date:** 587
**Juans:** 2
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T0408

## Contributors
- 闍那崛多 (A001844)

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

The *Xūkōngyùn púsà jīng* in 2 fascicles is [闍那崛多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%97%8D%E9%82%A3%E5%B4%9B%E5%A4%9A) Jñānagupta's Suí-period translation of the Ākāśagarbha sūtra. The Taishō print signs the entry "隋天竺三藏闍那崛多譯" and explicitly cross-references *Nos. 405–407* — the parallel translations by [佛陀耶舍](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E4%BD%9B%E9%99%80%E8%80%B6%E8%88%8D) Buddhayaśas ([KR6h0009](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0009)), the anonymous [KR6h0010](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0010), and [曇摩蜜多](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%9B%87%E6%91%A9%E8%9C%9C%E5%A4%9A) Dharmamitra ([KR6h0011](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6h/KR6h0011)). The Chinese title uses a slightly different lexical choice — *Yùn* 孕 "to bear/conceive" rather than *Zàng* 藏 "treasury" — for the *garbha* element of the bodhisattva's name; both renderings are attested in the Chinese Ākāśagarbha tradition, with *Xūkōngzàng* 虛空藏 eventually predominating.

**Abstract**

The opening narrative is essentially the same as that of the parallel translations: the Buddha is in residence at *Khalāṭika* mountain (佉羅坻迦山) where the saints of antiquity dwelt, the assembly is gathered, and the *cintāmaṇi* manifests in the western quarter, accompanied by [虛空藏](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%99%9B%E7%A9%BA%E8%97%8F) Ākāśagarbha. Jñānagupta's rendering is fuller than the parallel single-fascicle translations, expanding to two fascicles, and includes additional doctrinal exposition of the bodhisattva's vow and dhāraṇī. The dating window 587–600 reflects the bracket of Jñānagupta's principal Suí-period translation activity at Cháng'ān under [文帝](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%96%87%E5%B8%9D) Wéndì (r. 581–604), where he was the senior figure in the *Dàxīngshàn* 大興善 monastery's translation establishment. The *Lìdài sānbǎo jì* 歷代三寶紀 (T2034, completed 597) records the work among Jñānagupta's translations.
